text:
One day —God willing!—

you must love me a little.

I will raise the little hut

where the two of us will live.


What more to ask? With your love,

my hut, a tree, a dog,

and before us the sky and the hill

and the little coffee grove in bloom...


And amid elder aromas,

a mockingbird that would sing

and a pool that would copy

little birds and vines.


What we poor people want,

what we poor people love,

that which we adore so much

because it is what we do not have...


With only that, my life;

with only that:

with my verse, with your kiss,

everything else would be surplus...


Because there is nothing better

than a mountain, a hut, a star,

when one has an "I love you"

and the paths smell of flowers...

translation.title: One Day —God Willing!...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the humble wish-list and the repeated enoughness of love.
